131618: Igarashi is a short young adult woman of a relatively slender build and is often confused for a child. Because of this, she gets treated like one which annoys her. She usually has her shoulder-length green hair tied in a ponytail and forest green eyes.
131619: Sakurai Touko is one of the secondary characters in My Senpai is Annoying. Sakurai is a young adult woman with long black hair. She has a mole under her right eye.
131620: Takeda Harumi is one of the main characters in My Senpai is Annoying. He is a senpai to a junior employee at a company who finds him annoying. He is reliable but dense. Takeda is a large well build man with short black hair.
131621: Kazama Souta is one of the secondary characters in My Senpai is Annoying. He is a senpai at Igarashi Futaba's company. Kazama is a young adult with short black hair, who can be seen in a white button-up shirt with black working pants and occasionally, a blue necktie.
131622: Natsumi Kurobe is a childhood friend of Futaba Igarashi since middle school. She genuinely cares about her friends, but likes practical jokes.
244077: Yuuto Sakurai is the younger brother of Touko Sakurai. He used his enrollment in high school as an opportunity to move to his sister's town.
244078: Tsukishiro has a unique presence and manner of speaking. Her behavior and activity is quite strange, like bringing a love article into the office or licking Igarashi's fingers to heal her papercut. She often uses Russian phrases when greeting people.
